memo:
EdgeHound Portfolio Review — 2026-06-23

Portfolio is down 13.6% from inception ($10K → $8,637 equity) on 182 settled trades. The performance picture is highly bifurcated by engine. SHORT_FAVORITE remains the structural anchor: 114 trades, 72% win rate on sports/high-price markets, validated hypothesis with tight CI (65–79%). Its -$345 PnL at 72% win rate signals that sizing on losses (flat $100–150 per trade) is roughly breaking even after occasional bad resolutions like the CWS double-hit this session. The edge is real and should be protected.

MOMENTUM is the primary bleeder: 21 trades, 38% win rate, -$1,019. This engine was correctly disabled in the prior session. SMART_CONSENSUS has 1 trade and -$385 — appears to have taken a single oversized position on weak signal. Both remain correctly disabled.

VOLUME_SPIKE is marginally profitable (+$190, 8/20) but hypothesis CI is wide (29–71%) — insufficient evidence to draw strong conclusions. ELITE_FOLLOW is slightly positive (+$82, 13/26) with a forming mid-other hypothesis at 57% win rate. Both are acceptable to maintain at current exposure levels.

Brier score of 0.236 is acceptable but not strong — model calibration needs monitoring. The aenews2 wallet at 44% win rate (forming hypothesis) warrants continued skepticism. denizz at 0.8 score and donthackme at 0.6 are the highest-quality ELITE_FOLLOW sources.

No parameter changes warranted this session. SHORT_FAVORITE configuration is working. Current conservative posture (kellyMult 0.15, maxExposure 0.38) is appropriate given the drawdown. Patience is the correct posture while the validated engine continues to compound.
observations: SHORT_FAVORITE validated at 72.5% win rate on high-priced sports (n=107, CI 65–79%) — the core edge is intact
MOMENTUM disabled correctly — 38% win rate, -$1,019 over 21 trades is structural not noise
SMART_CONSENSUS disabled correctly — single -$385 trade, no sample base
VOLUME_SPIKE marginally positive (+$190) but 50% win rate on non-sports with wide CI — watch, don't expand
ELITE_FOLLOW slightly positive (+$82) — denizz (0.8) and donthackme (0.6) wallet scores are strongest signals
aenews2 wallet at 44% win rate (n=14) — ELITE_FOLLOW should be selective; this wallet is likely diluting returns
CWS double-entry (both YES and NO on same game) appears in recent trades — potential logic bug in deduplication or opposite-side entries on same market; warrants investigation
Brier score 0.236 is borderline — model is not well-calibrated, pPredicted values frequently diverge from outcomes
Open position: Minnesota Twins (stake $500) is oversized relative to typical $100–150 SHORT_FAVORITE trade — verify this is intentional sizing, not a parameter drift
Total equity at $8,637 — drawdown warrants continued conservative sizing, no loosening of maxExposure
changeReasoning: No parameter changes warranted. SHORT_FAVORITE is the only validated edge engine and current conservative sizing (kellyMult 0.15, maxExposure 0.38) is appropriate during a drawdown period. MOMENTUM and SMART_CONSENSUS remain disabled — sample evidence is decisively negative for MOMENTUM and insufficient for SMART_CONSENSUS. VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW remain enabled with insufficient evidence to either expand or cut. Raising pMin or cutting kellyMult further would reduce trade frequency on the one working engine without clear benefit. Maintaining status quo is the disciplined choice.
riskFlags: SAME-GAME DOUBLE-ENTRY: Recent trades show both YES ($100) and NO ($150) on 'Cleveland Guardians vs. Chicago White Sox' and similar patterns — if this is the bot taking both sides of a market, it is guaranteed to lose on one leg and needs immediate logic review

OVERSIZED OPEN: Minnesota Twins position at $500 stake is 3-5x the typical SHORT_FAVORITE trade size — confirm this is within maxEventExposure logic and not a Kelly calculation error with a bloated bank estimate
EQUITY EROSION: At -13.6% from start, continued drawdown of similar magnitude would approach a point where position sizing materially compresses — monitor closely

aenews2 WALLET: 44% win rate follower is likely a net drag on ELITE_FOLLOW PnL; recommend the bot's wallet-scoring logic consider deprecating or zero-weighting this source if it reaches n=20 without improvement

BRIER CALIBRATION: Score of 0.236 suggests systematic overconfidence in pPredicted — if the model consistently predicts 0.70+ but true win rate is ~72% only on sports, non-sports model outputs are likely poorly calibrated
